descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Something is weaving a web through reality, and your room is the first thing it catches.

PUNCH YOUR WAY OUT
No buttons, no guns: your fists are the weapon. Punch attackers as they fly at you, knock their glowing shots out of the air, lean out of the way, duck under energy walls and clap to clear everything around you once per wave. A fast, straight punch counts; a soft touch does nothing.

YOUR ROOM FIRST
The run starts in mixed reality. Portals tear through your real walls, the Weaver watches you through them, and giant insects crawl out into your space. Survive and the room shatters around you.

FOUR WORLDS, ONE STORY
Fight on the web through the Neon City, the Hive, the burning Ruins and finally the Weaver's Lair. Each world has its own creatures, music and sky, and the Weaver comes closer every time. Hold the web through the last wave to see it fall, and close the breaches in your room for good.

BUILT FOR VR
- Attacks from all sides, with red warnings for the ones you cannot see
- Hand tracking or Touch controllers
- Seated or standing; seated play keeps attacks in front of you
- Combos that unlock powers: Power Fists, Second Wind, Shockwave
- Story, Easy, Normal and Hard; a crown for beating each
- Win to unlock Endless mode, with its own best scores
- No locomotion, fully offline

Loomfall is a short, intense arcade workout made for Quest 3 and Quest 3S.
